mapper.select: select count(distinct pc.problem_id) from problem_complete pc inner join problem p on p.problem_id = pc.problem_id and p.del_flag = 0 where pc.user_id = #{userId} and p.type = 1

select pc.problem_id as problem_id, coalesce(op.difficulty, 0) as difficulty from problem_complete pc inner join problem p on p.problem_id = pc.problem_id and p.del_flag = 0 left join oj_problem op on op.problem_id = pc.problem_id and op.del_flag = 0 where pc.user_id = #{userId} and p.type = 1 order by pc.problem_id desc limit #{limit}

select c.contest_id as contest_id, c.title, c.type, c.start_time as start_time, c.end_time as end_time from user_contest uc inner join contest c on c.contest_id = uc.contest_id and c.del_flag = 0 where uc.user_id = #{userId} order by c.start_time desc, c.contest_id desc limit #{limit}
